answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: the ledger groups accounts whose answers, timing and funding paths move together, and a cluster shares one reward share however many members it has. The farmer pays: each fake needs its own hardware, schedule and writing style to stay an island, so upkeep grows per identity while payout does not. Rewards wait in a vault until clustering runs. Failure case: an attacker who rotates onyx-themed wording still shares funding sources and gets merged.
